Army Customisation allows you to further individualise your force. Archetypes change how you build your army by moving around units in the Army Organisation Plan (AOP) or letting you take more of a unit than you would normally be allowed to. Legacies give access to armories and disciplines of legendary factions. Traits enhance your units with special abilities that they normally would not be able to have.

You may select up to the following:
0-1 Archetype, 0-1 Legacy
- Every model in the army with access to the Armory may select a single item from any Chaos faction, instead of from Imperial factions.
- Every model in the army with access to the Armory may select a single item from any Xenos faction, instead of from Imperial factions.
- Henchman Warbands consisting of 5+ Acolytes can be taken without requiring an Inquisitor and when done so have a size of 5-10 specialists.
The army has access to the Ordo Hereticus Armory.
The army has access to the Ordo Malleus Armory.
The army has access to the Ordo Xenos Armory.
Every character model in the army may select a single item from either the Ordo Hereticus, Malleus or Xenos Armory.
